# HTMLPurifier through twig extension is not adhering to cache dir config

using the latest PrestaShop, the HTMLPurifier is creating cache files in `vendor/ezyang/htmlpurifier/library/HTMLPurifier/DefinitionCache`

unlike `Tools::purifyHTML`, it is not adhering to the _PS_CACHE_DIR_ configuration. https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/develop/src/PrestaShopBundle/Utils/HTMLPurifier.php probably needs similar

```diff
+ $config->set('Cache.SerializerPath', _PS_CACHE_DIR_ . 'purifier');
```

## Attendu
purifier cache files present at `var/cache`
